description: This file defines a service class 'LaunchService' providing static methods to open email clients and Google Maps with specified parameters.

classes.name: LaunchService
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to launch email clients and maps applications.

methods.name: email
methods.description: Opens the default email client with prefilled 'to', 'subject', and 'body' fields.

methods.name: openMaps
methods.description: Opens Google Maps at specified latitude and longitude with an optional query string.

methods.name: _launch
methods.description: Internal helper method to launch a URL using the url_launcher package; throws an exception if unable to launch.
